import Foundation

let url = URL(string: "http://127.0.0.1:18923/api/products")!

var fetchError: Error?

    fetchError = err
    semaphore.signal()

    print("Error: \(fetchError?.localizedDescription ?? "Unknown")")
    exit(1)

    let name: String
    let price: Double
}

var products: [Product] = []
for item in json {
    let name = item["name"] as! String
    let price = (item["price"] as! NSNumber).doubleValue
    products.append(Product(name: name, price: price))
}

let filtered = products.filter { $0.price > 50.00 }.sorted { $0.name < $1.name }

print("=== Filtered Products (price > $50.00) ===")

for p in filtered {
    print("\(p.name): $\(String(format: "%.2f", p.price))")
}
print("")
print("Count: \(filtered.count)")
